title: Chicken sausage and root vegetable traybake
toddlerSplit: Cut the toddlers' sausages lengthways into strips — never into coins, which are a choking risk at this age. Skip the mustard glaze on their half.
steps: Oven to 200C. Halve the potatoes, cut parsnips into batons, quarter the onions.
Toss everything except the sausages with oil, rosemary and salt. Roast 20 minutes.
Add the sausages, roast a further 20 minutes, turning once.
Set aside the toddlers' share and slice their sausages lengthways.
Whisk mustard with a splash of the pan juices, drizzle over the adult half.
